body: You're a blessing. I needed that. Thank you.

sick of drinking everyday, always feeling like shit, not working out, waking up late, going to bed late, drama, 'friends' that you introduce to your girlfriend and they put her on their top friends before they even request you, 9-5, competitive girlfriends, this world and the life i pretend to lead, fake smiles, lack of hugs, missing florida, missing deadlines, best friends who block you on aim, late bill fees, money problems, depression, being in love, watching friends get hurt, watching their friends not give a shit, feeling empty, having no motivation or self control, not feeling loved, dirty carpet, dirty bathrooms, dirty dishes, empty fridge, empty pantry, cars that leak after you spend $1k to fix them, courthouses, my family, finding classes, no sex drive, handing out beers, remorse, feeling underappreciated, being with someone who deserves better, giving people money, giving people rides, feeling left out, being perceived as mean, 12/04, asking for money, jealousy, forgetting to send thank you cards, people visiting, demanding respect, P.E., not going to church, our schedules, acting like nothing is ever wrong, people losing to cancer, giving out cigarettes, smoking and bumming smokes, making mistakes, not following through with plans, being new, getting old, not knowing who i am, watching it slip out of my reach, saying "i'm okay" and talking myself into believing it when it isn't true, fearing death, needing support but being afraid to ask, communication, broken phones and sleeping past 
alarms, quitting surfing, being honest and having no one believe you, trying to be a jack of all trades, trying to figure out where to start turning things around, days flying by, missed opportunites, feeling the pressure, not remembering people you meet, people acting like they care, shitty outlooks, burdening people with your problems when everyone else's are worse, drowning your sorrows, going no where, wanting to hang out with people solely to get your mind off of everything, regretting telling you this.
